blocks.zh: Topic 7：效價測定策略
blocks.en: Topic 7: Potency Assay Strategy

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解效價（potency）的定義，並區分其與臨床療效（clinical efficacy）的本質差異
blocks.en: Understand the definition of potency and how it fundamentally differs from clinical efficacy

blocks.zh: 掌握有效效價分析方法（potency assay）的核心屬性，包括 MOA 連結性、穩定性指示能力，以及參考標準的建立策略
blocks.en: Understand the core attributes of an effective potency assay, including its link to the MOA, its stability-indicating capability, and the strategy for establishing reference standards

blocks.zh: 了解矩陣式方法（matrix approach）在 ATMP 效價開發中的演進邏輯，從早期替代指標到商業化 MOA 反映型分析
blocks.en: Understand the logic by which the matrix approach evolves in ATMP potency development, from early surrogate measures to commercial MOA-reflective assays

blocks.zh: 掌握 pDNA/mRNA 特殊情境下 FDA 接受的效價替代指標，以及 QC 放行分析設計的實務原則
blocks.en: Understand the potency surrogates FDA accepts in the special case of pDNA/mRNA, and the practical principles for designing QC release assays

blocks.zh: 認識 FDA 2023 草案指南中「效價保證策略（potency assurance strategy）」的多面向框架，及其對 CDMO 運作的影響
blocks.en: Become familiar with the multifaceted framework of the "potency assurance strategy" in FDA's 2023 draft guidance and its impact on CDMO operations

blocks.zh: Q7.1 — Key Attributes of an Effective Product-Specific Potency Assay Q7.1 — 有效之產品專屬效價測定法的關鍵屬性
blocks.en: Q7.1 — Key Attributes of an Effective Product-Specific Potency Assay

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：效價、藥效與臨床療效的三角關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Triangle of Potency, Pharmacological Activity and Clinical Efficacy

blocks.zh: Potency（效價）：產生特定生物效果所需的藥物劑量或濃度。這是一個體外可量測的生物活性數值，例如 AAV 載體感染 HEK293 細胞後，GOI 表現之酵素活性 (enzymatic activity) IU/mL。
blocks.en: Potency: The dose or concentration of drug needed to produce a specific biological effect. It is a biological activity value measurable in vitro, for example the enzymatic activity (IU/mL) of the GOI expressed after an AAV vector infects HEK293 cells.

blocks.zh: Clinical Efficacy（臨床療效）：藥物在真實病患身上的治療有效性，僅能在臨床試驗中驗證。舉例而言，罕見溶酶體儲積症 (lysosomal storage disease) 基因治療的臨床療效，是指病患器官功能改善、生化指標恢復正常。
blocks.en: Clinical Efficacy: The therapeutic effectiveness of the drug in real patients, which can only be demonstrated in clinical trials. For example, the clinical efficacy of a gene therapy for a rare lysosomal storage disease means improved organ function and normalization of biochemical markers in patients.

blocks.zh: 兩者的關鍵連結：法規機構要求效價分析必須能可驗證地連結（demonstrable link）到臨床療效。這意味著：
blocks.en: The key link between the two: Regulators require the potency assay to have a demonstrable link to clinical efficacy. This means:

blocks.zh: AAV 基因治療（蛋白替代）：體外酵素活性測定值需與動物模型中酵素替代療效有統計相關性
blocks.en: AAV gene therapy (protein replacement): The in vitro enzymatic activity value must be statistically correlated with the enzyme replacement effect in animal models

blocks.zh: CAR-T 細胞治療：體外腫瘤殺傷能力（in vitro tumor killing assay）需與動物或臨床腫瘤縮小的 in vivo 結果相關
blocks.en: CAR-T cell therapy: The in vitro tumor killing assay must correlate with in vivo results, either tumor shrinkage in animals or in the clinic

blocks.zh: 簡言之：效價是臨床療效的體外代理指標，必須有充分數據證明兩者的關聯。沒有此連結，效價測定就只是一個數字，對法規審查毫無意義。
blocks.en: In short: potency is the in vitro surrogate of clinical efficacy, and sufficient data must show that the two are related. Without this link, a potency assay is just a number and means nothing to regulatory reviewers.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：引擎測功機 vs. 上路試駕
blocks.en: Analogy: Engine Dynamometer vs. Road Test

blocks.zh: 把效價分析想成在測功機（dynamometer）上測量汽車引擎馬力——不是把車開上公路看跑多快，而是在受控的實驗室條件下精確測量引擎輸出功率。
blocks.en: Think of a potency assay as measuring a car engine's horsepower on a dynamometer: instead of driving the car on the highway to see how fast it goes, you precisely measure the engine's power output under controlled laboratory conditions.

blocks.zh: 測功機數值 = Potency（效價）：量化、可重現、可控制條件下測得的生物活性數值。
blocks.en: Dynamometer reading = Potency: A quantitative, reproducible biological activity value measured under controlled conditions.

blocks.zh: 上路實際表現 = Clinical Efficacy（臨床療效）：受道路條件、天氣、駕駛習慣影響，難以在開發階段精確預測。
blocks.en: Actual road performance = Clinical Efficacy: Affected by road conditions, weather and driving habits, and hard to predict precisely during development.

blocks.zh: 法規要求的「demonstrable link」就是要你證明：測功機測出 500 馬力的引擎，上路後確實比 300 馬力的引擎快——這個相關性必須用數據建立，不能只假設。
blocks.en: The regulatory "demonstrable link" means you must show that an engine measured at 500 horsepower on the dynamometer really is faster on the road than one measured at 300 horsepower. This correlation must be established with data, not just assumed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：穩定性指示分析 (Stability-Indicating Assay) 設計要點
blocks.en: Key Point: Design Essentials of a Stability-Indicating Assay

blocks.zh: 許多團隊誤以為效價只是放行用途。PtC-11 明確強調：效價是穩定性 CQA，因此效價分析必須能偵測到因儲存降解造成的活性下降。
blocks.en: Many teams mistakenly think potency is only for release. PtC-11 stresses explicitly that potency is a stability CQA, so the potency assay must be able to detect the loss of activity caused by degradation during storage.

blocks.zh: 強制降解研究（Forced Degradation Study）設計原則：
blocks.en: Design principles for a forced degradation study:

blocks.zh: 每個降解條件目標：達到 10–20% 的降解幅度（過高降解會破壞產品結構，偵測不到真實降解路徑）
blocks.en: Target for each degradation condition: 10–20% degradation (too much degradation destroys the product structure, and the real degradation pathway is no longer detected)

blocks.zh: 常見條件：熱降解（elevated temperature）、氧化（H₂O₂ 處理）、光照（ICH Q1B）、機械剪切（freeze-thaw cycles）
blocks.en: Common conditions: elevated temperature, oxidation (H₂O₂ treatment), light exposure (ICH Q1B), mechanical stress (freeze-thaw cycles)

blocks.zh: 必須以正交方法（orthogonal methods）確認降解程度，例如 SEC-HPLC 確認蛋白聚集、流式細胞儀確認細胞活性下降
blocks.en: The extent of degradation must be confirmed by orthogonal methods, for example SEC-HPLC for protein aggregation and flow cytometry for the decrease in cell viability

blocks.zh: 確認降解後，效價分析必須能定量偵測到對應的活性損失
blocks.en: Once degradation is confirmed, the potency assay must be able to quantitatively detect the corresponding loss of activity

blocks.zh: 若效價分析無法偵測到降解樣品的活性下降，它就不是穩定性指示性分析，不能用於穩定性研究，法規審查時將面臨重大挑戰。
blocks.en: If the potency assay cannot detect the loss of activity in degraded samples, it is not a stability-indicating assay, cannot be used in stability studies, and will face major challenges at regulatory review.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 參考標準橋接策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Reference Standard Bridging Strategy

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP CDMO 的實際作業中，參考標準的演進通常經歷三個階段：
blocks.en: In actual ATMP CDMO operations, the evolution of the reference standard usually goes through three stages:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 IND 申請前：使用開發批次作為臨時參考標準（interim RS）。此時需詳細記錄批次特性（GMP 批次還是研究批次、製程版本、效價測定方法版本）。
blocks.en: Before the Phase 1 IND: Use a development batch as the interim reference standard (interim RS). The batch characteristics must be documented in detail at this point (GMP or research batch, process version, version of the potency assay method).

blocks.zh: Phase 2/3 過渡期：製備並資格確認初級參考標準（primary RS）——需以 GMP 批次、充足的穩定性數據、全套特性分析支持。
blocks.en: Phase 2/3 transition: Prepare and qualify the primary reference standard (primary RS), supported by a GMP batch, sufficient stability data and a full characterization package.

blocks.zh: 橋接研究（Bridging Study）：新 RS 引入時，必須以平行測試方式建立新舊 RS 的定量關聯，確保早期臨床批次的效價數據與新 RS 體系一致可追溯。
blocks.en: Bridging Study: When a new RS is introduced, a quantitative relationship between the old and new RS must be established by parallel testing, ensuring that the potency data of early clinical batches remain consistent and traceable with the new RS system.

blocks.zh: 關鍵實務建議：在臨時 RS 階段就開始建立大量生物分析特性數據（bioanalytical characterization data）。這些數據一旦發現效價分析需要調整，就是橋接的救命稻草。文件記錄要做到有人能在 5 年後重建每一批次的效價歷史。
blocks.en: Key practical recommendation: Start building extensive bioanalytical characterization data at the interim RS stage. If the potency assay later needs to be adjusted, these data are the lifeline for bridging. Documentation should be good enough that someone can reconstruct the potency history of every batch 5 years later.

blocks.zh: Q7.2 — Acceptable Approaches for Phasing in a Product-Specific Potency Assay Q7.2 — 分階段導入產品專屬效價測定法的可行方法
blocks.en: Q7.2 — Acceptable Approaches for Phasing in a Product-Specific Potency Assay

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：健康檢查套餐 vs. 單一指標
blocks.en: Analogy: Comprehensive Health Checkup vs. a Single Indicator

blocks.zh: 矩陣式效價方法就像全套健康檢查，不是只看一項指標決定你健不健康：
blocks.en: A matrix potency approach is like a full health checkup: you do not decide whether you are healthy from a single indicator:

blocks.zh: 血糖（fasting glucose）= DNA copy number → 必要但不充分
blocks.en: Fasting glucose = DNA copy number → necessary but not sufficient

blocks.zh: 肝功能指數（ALT/AST）= 載體顆粒數 → 結構完整性指標
blocks.en: Liver function index (ALT/AST) = vector particle count → indicator of structural integrity

blocks.zh: 心臟壓力測試 = Cell-based 腫瘤殺傷測試 → 功能性最終驗證
blocks.en: Cardiac stress test = cell-based tumor killing assay → final functional confirmation

blocks.zh: 心電圖定量 = Binding assay 對比 RS → 定量功能性基準
blocks.en: Quantitative ECG = binding assay against the RS → quantitative functional benchmark

blocks.zh: 單一指標偏高或偏低可能只是雜訊，但多項指標的綜合圖像才能真正反映健康狀態。同理，矩陣中沒有任何單一分析能獨立定義效價——是各項分析共同構成完整的效價畫面。
blocks.en: A single indicator being high or low may be just noise, but the combined picture from multiple indicators truly reflects health. Likewise, no single assay in the matrix can define potency on its own; the assays together form the complete potency picture.

blocks.zh: 而且，隨著年齡增長（=開發階段進展），健康檢查的項目和標準也會升級，這正是矩陣動態演進的本質。
blocks.en: Also, as you age (= as development progresses), the items and standards of the checkup are upgraded, which is the essence of the matrix evolving dynamically.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：pDNA/mRNA 的特殊效價策略
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Potency Strategy for pDNA/mRNA

blocks.zh: pDNA 和 mRNA 作為藥品時，面臨一個根本性的挑戰：它們的 MOA 必須在體內轉錄/翻譯後才能發揮作用，因此沒有直接的體外 MOA 分析可用。
blocks.en: When pDNA and mRNA are the drug product, there is a fundamental challenge: their MOA only takes effect after transcription/translation in vivo, so no direct in vitro MOA assay is available.

blocks.zh: FDA 接受的替代指標（Surrogates）組合：
blocks.en: Combination of surrogates accepted by FDA:

blocks.zh: 直接核酸定量（Direct nucleic acid quantitation）：確認 pDNA 或 mRNA 的含量與規格一致
blocks.en: Direct nucleic acid quantitation: Confirms that the amount of pDNA or mRNA is consistent with the specification

blocks.zh: 超螺旋完整性測定（Supercoil measurement，適用 pDNA）：確認 pDNA 的超螺旋比例，因超螺旋形式轉染效率最高；降解或開環形式效力顯著下降
blocks.en: Supercoil measurement (for pDNA): Confirms the supercoiled fraction of the pDNA, because the supercoiled form has the highest transfection efficiency; degraded or open-circular forms have markedly lower potency

blocks.zh: 完整性分析（Integrity，適用 mRNA）：確認 mRNA 無降解截斷片段，通常以毛細管電泳或 Bioanalyzer 測定
blocks.en: Integrity assay (for mRNA): Confirms that the mRNA has no degraded or truncated fragments, usually measured by capillary electrophoresis or Bioanalyzer

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：這是 FDA 在特定情境下接受的折衷方案，不是通則。使用替代指標必須提交強健的數據包，證明替代指標與效力的相關性（例如超螺旋比例與體外轉染效率、或與動物 in vivo 蛋白表現量的相關性）。
blocks.en: Important reminder: This is a compromise FDA accepts in specific situations; it is not a general rule. Using surrogates requires submitting a robust data package demonstrating the correlation of the surrogate with potency (for example, the supercoiled fraction against in vitro transfection efficiency, or against in vivo protein expression in animals).

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 QC 放行分析設計原則
blocks.en: Practical Application: Design Principles for CDMO QC Release Assays

blocks.zh: 身為 CDMO，當客戶帶著複雜的研究級效價分析方法要求放行使用時，需要協助客戶重新思考以下問題：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when a client brings a complex research-grade potency assay and asks to use it for release, you need to help the client rethink the following questions:

blocks.zh: 可執行性：分析是否可在 QC 實驗室環境（非研究環境）中由標準訓練水準的分析師執行？
blocks.en: Executability: Can the assay be performed in a QC laboratory environment (not a research environment) by analysts with standard training?

blocks.zh: 重現性：批次間、分析師間、設備間的重現性數據（%CV）是否符合驗證接受標準？
blocks.en: Reproducibility: Do the reproducibility data (%CV) between batches, analysts and instruments meet the validation acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: 週轉時間：細胞培養基礎的功能分析通常需要 3–7 天，是否符合產品放行時間要求？
blocks.en: Turnaround time: Cell culture-based functional assays usually take 3–7 days; does this meet the product release time requirements?

blocks.zh:
替代分析的數據包：若提議使用更簡單的替代指標，需準備：
(1) 正常樣品 vs. 降解樣品的相關性研究
(2) 人工低效價樣品（reduced potency）和高效價樣品（elevated potency）的驗證數據
(3) 多地點轉移（technology transfer）可行性評估
blocks.en:
Data package for a surrogate assay: If a simpler surrogate is proposed, prepare:
(1) a correlation study of normal vs. degraded samples
(2) validation data with artificially reduced-potency and elevated-potency samples
(3) a feasibility assessment for multi-site technology transfer

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略建議：在合約簽訂前的技術評估（technical feasibility assessment）階段，即主動與客戶討論效價分析的可行性，避免在 BLA 申請前夕才發現無法執行的分析方法。
blocks.en: CDMO strategy recommendation: At the technical feasibility assessment stage before contract signing, proactively discuss the feasibility of the potency assay with the client, so that an unworkable method is not discovered on the eve of the BLA submission.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：效價分析問題是 IND/BLA 延誤的首要原因
blocks.en: Key Point: Potency Assay Problems Are the Leading Cause of IND/BLA Delays

blocks.zh: PtC-11 明確指出：近年來許多 IND 申請和 BLA 許可核准均因效價分析問題而延誤。這是法規實務上不容忽視的警示。
blocks.en: PtC-11 states clearly that in recent years many IND submissions and BLA approvals have been delayed because of potency assay problems. This is a warning in regulatory practice that cannot be ignored.

blocks.zh: 常見的延誤場景：
blocks.en: Common delay scenarios:

blocks.zh: Phase 3 試驗中途才發現效價分析不是穩定性指示性的，需重新設計並橋接
blocks.en: Discovering midway through a Phase 3 trial that the potency assay is not stability-indicating, requiring redesign and bridging

blocks.zh: BLA 申請後收到 FDA 資訊要求（Information Request），要求補充 MOA 連結數據
blocks.en: Receiving an FDA Information Request after the BLA submission asking for supplementary MOA-link data

blocks.zh: 商業化生產前夕，效價分析無法成功轉移到商業化地點
blocks.en: On the eve of commercial manufacture, the potency assay cannot be successfully transferred to the commercial site

blocks.zh: 參考標準體系未建立，早期臨床批次的效價數據無法追溯
blocks.en: The reference standard system was not established, so the potency data of early clinical batches cannot be traced

blocks.zh: 解決方案：早期與法規機構溝通。FDA 鼓勵申請人在 Pre-IND Meeting 或 Type B Meeting 中主動討論效價測定策略，提前取得 HA 的認可，比事後補救節省數倍時間與成本。
blocks.en: Solution: communicate early with the regulators. FDA encourages applicants to proactively discuss the potency assay strategy at a Pre-IND Meeting or Type B Meeting and to obtain health authority (HA) agreement early, which saves several times the time and cost of fixing the problem afterwards.

blocks.zh: 架構圖：FDA 2023 草案指南 — 效價保證策略框架 (Ref 16)
blocks.en: Framework Diagram: FDA 2023 Draft Guidance - Potency Assurance Strategy Framework (Ref 16)

blocks.zh:
效價保證策略 = 多面向整合方法
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. 製程設計 (Manufacturing Process  │
│     Design)                          │
│  ↓ 確保一致的產品品質                │
│  2. 製程管控 (Process Control)       │
│  ↓ CPP 監控與偏差預防                │
│  3. 原料管控 (Material Control)      │
│  ↓ 原物料規格、RS 管理               │
│  4. 製程中測試 (In-Process Testing) │
│  ↓ 早期效力信號監控                  │
│  5. 放行效價分析 (Lot Release Assay) │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
          ↓
    完整的效價保證體系
    （單一放行數字 ≠ 完整效價保證）
blocks.en:
Potency Assurance Strategy = Multifaceted Integrated Approach
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. Manufacturing Process Design     │
│  ↓ Ensures consistent product quality│
│  2. Process Control                  │
│  ↓ CPP monitoring, deviation         │
│     prevention                       │
│  3. Material Control                 │
│  ↓ Raw material specs, RS management │
│  4. In-Process Testing               │
│  ↓ Early potency signal monitoring   │
│  5. Lot Release Potency Assay        │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
          ↓
    Complete potency assurance system
    (a single release number ≠ complete potency assurance)

blocks.zh: 此框架的核心訊息是：效價不只是一個放行數字，而是需要從製程設計到最終放行的全鏈條管控。CDMO 在撰寫 Quality Agreement 時，應明確哪些層面由客戶負責、哪些由 CDMO 負責。
blocks.en: The core message of this framework is that potency is not just a release number but needs control along the whole chain, from process design to final release. When writing the Quality Agreement, the CDMO should state clearly which aspects are the client's responsibility and which are the CDMO's.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：矩陣式方法的臨床分期演進
blocks.en: Core Concept: Evolution of the Matrix Approach Across Clinical Phases

blocks.zh: 矩陣式方法（matrix approach）不是一個固定的測試組合，而是一個隨臨床分期動態演進的策略：
blocks.en: The matrix approach is not a fixed set of tests but a strategy that evolves dynamically with the clinical phase:

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念：矩陣中定量分析（quantitative，如 binding assay 對比 RS）與定性分析（qualitative，如 cell-based 通過/失敗）的相關性需在開發期間建立，才能在放行時合理使用兩者的組合。
blocks.en: Key concept: The correlation between the quantitative assays (for example, a binding assay against the RS) and the qualitative assays (for example, a cell-based pass/fail assay) in the matrix must be established during development, so that the combination of the two can be used reasonably at release.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: MOA 連結性：你的客戶正在開發一個 AAV9 基因治療產品，GOI 編碼一個目前功能尚未完全闡明的結構蛋白 (structural protein)。效價分析開發團隊應如何在 Phase 1 IND 中回應 FDA 對「demonstrable link between potency and clinical efficacy」的要求？你會建議使用哪種矩陣組合，並如何規劃 Phase 1 到 Phase 3 的分析演進路徑？
blocks.en: MOA link: Your client is developing an AAV9 gene therapy whose GOI encodes a structural protein whose function is not yet fully elucidated. How should the potency assay development team respond in the Phase 1 IND to FDA's requirement for a "demonstrable link between potency and clinical efficacy"? Which matrix combination would you recommend, and how would you plan the assay evolution path from Phase 1 to Phase 3?

blocks.zh: 穩定性指示性設計：你的 CAR-T 產品使用 in vitro 腫瘤殺傷分析（killing assay）作為效價方法。如何設計強制降解研究來驗證此分析的穩定性指示能力？列出至少三種降解條件，說明如何以正交方法確認降解程度，以及如何設計接受標準。
blocks.en: Stability-indicating design: Your CAR-T product uses an in vitro tumor killing assay as its potency method. How would you design a forced degradation study to verify the stability-indicating capability of this assay? List at least three degradation conditions, explain how to confirm the extent of degradation with orthogonal methods, and how to set the acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: pDNA 替代效價：客戶提交的 pDNA 藥品規格中，效價方法僅有 DNA 定量（OD260 吸光值）。你認為此方法是否足夠？如需補強，應加入哪些額外的替代效價指標，並說明每項指標的科學依據與 FDA 接受性。
blocks.en: pDNA surrogate potency: In the pDNA drug product specification submitted by the client, the only potency method is DNA quantitation (OD260 absorbance). Do you think this method is sufficient? If it needs strengthening, which additional surrogate potency measures should be added? Explain the scientific basis and FDA acceptability of each.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 效價 vs. 臨床療效：效價是定義效果所需濃度/劑量的活性測量；臨床療效是人體治療有效性。法規要求兩者有可驗證的科學連結，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Potency vs. clinical efficacy: Potency is a measure of activity that defines the concentration/dose needed for an effect; clinical efficacy is therapeutic effectiveness in humans. Regulators require a demonstrable scientific link between the two; neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 效價是安全性以外最重要的 CQA，且必須同時服務於放行和穩定性兩個目的——穩定性指示分析設計必須與強制降解研究同步規劃。
blocks.en: Potency is the most important CQA after safety, and it must serve both release and stability, so the design of the stability-indicating assay must be planned together with the forced degradation study.

blocks.zh: 矩陣式方法是 ATMP 效價開發的業界共識，從基本物理屬性出發，隨臨床進展演進為 MOA 反映型分析，最終於 BLA 前整合為簡化、穩健的商業放行方案。
blocks.en: The matrix approach is the industry consensus for ATMP potency development: starting from basic physical attributes, it evolves with clinical progress into MOA-reflective assays, and finally, before the BLA, is consolidated into a simplified, robust commercial release scheme.

blocks.zh: pDNA/mRNA 特例：FDA 接受核酸定量＋超螺旋完整性（pDNA）或完整性分析（mRNA）作為效價替代指標，但需要強健的相關性數據包支持。
blocks.en: The pDNA/mRNA special case: FDA accepts nucleic acid quantitation + supercoil integrity (pDNA) or an integrity assay (mRNA) as potency surrogates, but a robust correlation data package is required.

blocks.zh: 參考標準橋接：從臨時 RS 到初級 RS 的過渡必須嚴謹規劃，早期積累的生物分析特性數據是未來橋接的基礎。
blocks.en: Reference standard bridging: The transition from interim RS to primary RS must be planned rigorously, and the bioanalytical characterization data accumulated early are the basis for future bridging.

blocks.zh: FDA 2023 效價保證策略（Ref 16）提出五層次整合框架，CDMO 在品質協議中應明確各方效價保證責任分工。
blocks.en: FDA's 2023 potency assurance strategy (Ref 16) proposes a five-layer integrated framework; in the quality agreement the CDMO should define clearly how responsibilities for potency assurance are divided among the parties.

blocks.zh: 早期 HA 溝通是成功的關鍵——效價分析問題是近年 IND/BLA 延誤的首要原因，Pre-IND Meeting 即應主動提出效價策略。
blocks.en: Early HA communication is the key to success: Potency assay problems have been the leading cause of IND/BLA delays in recent years, and the potency strategy should be raised proactively at the Pre-IND Meeting.
